text.p: GP Batteries International Ltd, the Singapore-listed unit of Hong Kong Gold Peak Industries (Holdings) Ltd, said on Wednesday Victor Lo and Paul Lo have retired as directors with effect from August 13, 1997.
The battery maker and distributor said in a statement this was in line with the recent change in Gold Peak structure in which GP Batteries became an associate instead of a subsidiary.
Earlier this year, Gold Peak cut its 51 percent stake in GP Batteries to 45 percent, according to GP Batteries assistant general manager of finance, Petras Tsui.
Victor Lo was chairman of GP Batteries from 1990 to 1993. Paul Lo was one of the co-founder of the Gold Peak Group.
"The Los took this opportunity to allow management of GP Batteries to have more role in GP Batteries," Tsui told Reuters by telephone.
Tsui said the two had been spending more time developing business in Gold Peak's other electronic divisions, including Clipsal Industries Holdings Ltd.
Victor Lo is now chairman and chief executive of Gold Peak and chairman of Clipsal and GPE Industries. Paul Lo is on Gold Peak's board.
